stage1Boundary: Stage 1 validates the backend -> provider transformation only. Browser-side prompt assembly happens in the frontend before the request reaches the route and is NOT covered here; a green provider-wire capture is not evidence of preset-level equivalence.

tier2.reason: The mock listens on an ephemeral loopback port, so the authority is not a property of either backend.
tier2.harnessSource: tools/mock-provider/main.go: --port 0 asks the kernel for a free port

tier2.rule: the recorder origin is replaced with <mock>
tier2.reason: API_MAKERSUITE is a pinned literal, so the GoTavern leg reaches the recorder through its seam and the pinned leg through this transport redirect. The PATH -- including the API VERSION segment this scenario exists to observe -- and the ?key= parameter are untouched and ARE compared.

tier3.reason: It is a measurement of elapsed wall-clock time, so it differs on every run and no backend can match it; the value is a duration, not a contract.

name: makersuite-api-version-generate
purpose: D-H2, GENERATE URL: `gemini.apiVersion: v1` must drive the MAKERSUITE generate URL, so the provider receives `/v1/models/gemini-2.5-pro:generateContent?key=<key>` rather than the pinned default `/v1beta/...` (chat-completions.js:679 reads `getConfigValue('gemini.apiVersion','v1beta')`, :730 interpolates it into the URL). DISCRIMINATING BECAUSE: the API version lives IN THE RECORDED REQUEST TARGET, and the request target is compared exactly (only the recorder origin is normalized); an implementation that hardcodes the default -- the pre-fix Go behaviour -- records `/v1beta/models/...` and fails the raw-target comparison with the version as the only difference. The opposite mutation (hardcoding `v1`) is caught by the existing default-config scenario makersuite-nonstream, which records `/v1beta/models/...` with the same model and no config line, so the pair discriminates in both directions. The unit-level gate is TestGoogleChatAPIVersionFollowsTheConfig.
